hints.title: Inversion Endpoints
hints.text: A semi-decreasing subarray starts at index i and ends at index j such that nums[i] > nums[j].

hints.title: Group Indices by Value
hints.text: Group all occurring indices by their corresponding values in a hash map.

hints.title: Descending Sweep
hints.text: Iterate through distinct values in descending order, maintaining the minimum starting index seen so far to compute candidate lengths with the rightmost index of each value.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Grouping indices and sorting distinct keys.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) pairs times out for n = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary hash map storing index lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map indices by value and sweep descending to find maximum index span.
